Se vai competir pela primeira vez, certifique-se de ler todas as informações em [Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlterOpen2024#36040-perguntas-frequentes-faq) e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlterOpen2024#36040-perguntas-frequentes-faq) and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
You can also watch this [tutorial](https://youtu.be/EIdO91rkNDM).
